# maatify/php-return-target

> Framework-agnostic PHP library for stateless signed internal return-target tokens with public issue and verify workflows.

For consumer use, follow the Package Reference for the supported Public Contract. Visible in repository != supported consumer contract: source internals, tests, fixtures, undocumented methods, contributor files, AGENTS.md, and engineering standards are not consumer contracts.

## Primary consumer documentation

- [README.md](README.md) — package overview, current pre-release status, requirements, installation, Quick Usage, and Public Runtime API overview.
- [RETURN_TARGET_PACKAGE_REFERENCE.md](RETURN_TARGET_PACKAGE_REFERENCE.md) — canonical public/runtime/behavioral contract and complete Public Runtime API inventory.
- [docs/guides/USAGE_GUIDE.md](docs/guides/USAGE_GUIDE.md) — consumer integration workflows, boundaries, inputs, outputs, and rejection semantics.
- [examples/](examples/) — maintained examples using the documented Public API and production autoload.

## Project history

- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) — factual change history; Packagist development versions are externally resolvable, but no SemVer RC is published yet.

## Release and support

- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) — security, support, and private vulnerability reporting policy.
